say:1:1520437001:0.source_cn: 就是这里了……这就是爸爸妈妈的坟墓。

say:2:1520437002:0.text: Please, Sir Mage... let me see them one more time!
say:2:1520437002:0.source_cn: 魔法师大人，求求您，让我再见一次他们吧……！

say:4:1520437003:0.text: ... Alright. Enough with the puppy dog eyes. I'll try. No promises, though.
say:4:1520437003:0.source_cn: ……知道了，别用那种眼神看着我，我可不保证成功。

say:5:1520437004:0.text: We need a catalyst for the spell. A specific one.
say:5:1520437004:0.source_cn: 我看看……要用那个魔法的话，还需要一样媒介。

say:6:1520437005:0.text: I need a <style="highlight">crimson pearl from a hawk moth's wings</style>.

choice_prompt:7:1520437005.text: I need a <style="highlight">crimson pearl from a hawk moth's wings</style>.
choice_prompt:7:1520437005.source_cn: <style=highlight>鹰蛾羽翅上的赤红死珠</style>，需要用它做施法材料。

say:8:1520437006:0.text: I wish. Only the God of Death can do that.
say:8:1520437006:0.source_cn: 我倒是想，那是只有死神才能做到的事。
say:8:1520437006:0.male: I wish. Only the God of Death can do that.
say:8:1520437006:0.female: I wish. Only the God of Death can do that.

say:9:1520437007:0.text: But... heh. Why should he get all the interesting magic?
say:9:1520437007:0.source_cn: 不过……哼。凭什么只有死神才能玩弄别人的生死？
say:9:1520437007:0.male: But... heh. Why should he get all the interesting magic?
say:9:1520437007:0.female: But... heh. Why should he get all the interesting magic?

say:10:1520437009:0.text: Don't just stand there, Third Seat. Let's go find the material.
say:10:1520437009:0.source_cn: 别愣着了，第三席。出发，找施法材料去。
say:10:1520437009:0.male: Don't just stand there, Third Seat. Let's go find the material.
say:10:1520437009:0.female: Don't just stand there, Third Seat. Let's go find the material.

say:11:1520437010:0.text: We should be able to find hawk moths in the <style="highlight">swamp southwest of Mirehold</style>.

say:11:1520437010:0.female: We should be able to find hawk moths in the <style="highlight">swamp southwest of Mirehold</style>.
